name: Student Volunteer Program at Edward Hospital
what_you_do: Help patients and visitors in the hospital as a student volunteer. You might be a greeter or work in the gift shop. Roles differ by location.
who_can_apply: High school students. Endeavor Health says most roles are for age 16 and up, but age 14 and up at Edward and Elmhurst hospitals. Health screening and orientation are required.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The student form says more students apply than there are spots.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online Student application. The hospital will contact the people it picks about next steps. If you have questions, call Volunteer Services at 630-527-3034.
notes: Hours per week and the length of service are not on the pages read. Ask Volunteer Services. Background checks are only for ages 18 and up.
